76407.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in having energy aroused; Soṇa Koḷivisa
76407.commentary: (ANa) soṇo koḷiviso'ti soṇo'ti tassa nāmaṃ, koḷiviso'ti gottaṃ. koṭivesso'ti vā attho, issariyena koṭippattassa vessakulassa dārako'ti adhippāyo. yasmā pana aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vīriyaṃ nāma vaḍḍhetabbaṃ hoti, therassa pana hāpetabbam'eva ahosi. tasmā esa āraddhavīriyānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.
76407.notes: Theragāthā verses 632-644 (TH13.1, TH243) are attributed to him.

76408.meaning1: family name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in having energy aroused; Soṇa Koḷivisa
76408.commentary: (ANa) soṇo koḷiviso'ti soṇo'ti tassa nāmaṃ, koḷiviso'ti gottaṃ. koṭivesso'ti vā attho, issariyena koṭippattassa vessakulassa dārako'ti adhippāyo. yasmā pana aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vīriyaṃ nāma vaḍḍhetabbaṃ hoti, therassa pana hāpetabbam'eva ahosi. tasmā esa āraddhavīriyānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

76409.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; Sāriputta's younger brother; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in forest dwelling; Revata Khadiravaniya
76409.commentary: (ANa) revato khadiravaniyo'ti dhammasenāpatittherassa kaniṭṭhabhātiko. so yathā aññe therā araññe vasamānā vanasabhāgaṃ udakasabhāgaṃ bhikkhācārasabhāgañ'ca sallakkhetvā araññe vasanti, na evaṃ vasi. etāni pana sabhāgāni anādiyitvā ujjaṅgalasakkharapāsāṇavisame khadiravane paṭivasati. tasmā āraññakānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.
76409.notes: Theragāthā verses 645-658 (TH14.1, TH244) are attributed to him.

76411.notes: Theragāthā verses 747-768 (TH16.3, TH250) are attributed to him.

76412.commentary: (MNa) gāḷhapalepanenā'ti bahalalepanena. (MNa) gāḷh'ūpalepanenā'ti bahal'ūpalepanena, punappunaṃ visarañjitena, na pana khaliyā littena viya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mālukyaputta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhapalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.

76413.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk among those coming from an eminent family
76413.commentary: (THa) so ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kapilavatthunagare sākiyarājakule nibbatti, bhaddiyo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so vayappatto anuruddh'ādīhi pañcahi khattiyehi saddhiṃ satthari anupiyambavane viharante satthu santike pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. taṃ satthā aparabhāge jetavane ariyagaṇamajjhe nisinno uccākulikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesi. so phalasukhena nibbānasukhena ca vītināmento araññagato'pi rukkhamūlagato'pi suññ'āgāragato'pi aho sukhaṃ, aho sukhan'ti abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi. (THa) putto godhāyā'ti kāḷigodhāya nāma khattiyāya putto. bhaddiyo'ti evaṃnāmo attānam'eva thero aññaṃ viya katvā vadati.
76413.notes: Theragāthā verses 842-865 (TH16.7, TH254) are attributed to him.

examples.text: sojja bhaddo sātatiko, uñchāpatt'āgate rato, jhāyati anupādāno, putto godhāya bhaddiyo.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uccākulikānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāyaputto.

76418.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of thoka
76418.meaning1: a little; a tiny bit; a small amount

examples.text: sā vejjenāgantvā kīdisaṃ, bhadde'ti puṭṭhā, pubbe me akkhīni thokaṃ rujiṃsu, idāni pana atirekataraṃ rujantī'ti āha
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ cittaṃ. yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, upamā'pi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittan'ti.

76423.synonym: dhaṃsita, bhagga, bhañjita, viddhasta, vinaṭṭha, vināsita
76423.commentary: (DNa) yasā nihīno'ti yaṃ lābh'aggayas'aggaṃ patto, tato parihīno hutvā.

examples.text: atha kho, bhaggava, acelo kaḷāramaṭṭako nacirass'eva parihito sānucāriko vicaranto odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān'eva vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nihīno kālam'akāsi.

76424.meaning1: having this field; within this domain
76424.commentary: (MNa) etaṃ patho'ham'asmi etaṃ gocaro'ti esa mayhaṃ patho esa gocaro'ti attho.

examples.text: ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā'ti? byākaramāno, bhikkhave, tathāgato evaṃ byākareyya, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassa, etaṃpatho'ham'asmi, etaṃgocaro, no ca tena tam'mayo'ti.
divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ.

76426.meaning1: net of sensual desire; web of sensual pleasures
76426.commentary: (THa) kāmajālā'ti kāmassa jālabhūtaṃ. yathā hi macchabandha-migaluddānaṃ jālaṃ nāma macch'ādīnaṃ tesaṃ yathākāmakārasādhanaṃ, evaṃ ayonisomanasikār'ānupātitaṃ cittaṃ mārassa kāmakārasādhanaṃ.

examples.text: olaggessāmi te citta, āṇidvāre'va hatthinaṃ, na taṃ pāpe niyojessaṃ, kāmajāla sarīraja.

76427.commentary: (THa) dvāravivaraṃ gajo'va alabhanto nagarato gajanirodhato vā niggamanāya dvāravivarakaṃ alabhamāno hatthī viya.

examples.text: tvaṃ olaggo na gacchasi, dvāravivaraṃ gajo'va alabhanto, na ca cittakali punappunaṃ, pasakka pāparato carissasi.

76428.meaning1: moving forward; going out; setting out

examples.text: tvaṃ olaggo na gacchasi, dvāravivaraṃ gajo'va alabhanto, na ca cittakali punappunaṃ, pasakka pāparato carissasi.

76429.meaning1: taking pleasure in evil; delighting in wrongdoing

examples.text: tvaṃ olaggo na gacchasi, dvāravivaraṃ gajo'va alabhanto, na ca cittakali punappunaṃ, pasakka pāparato carissasi.

76430.meaning1: makes turn around; makes revolve; turn to one's will
76430.commentary: (THa) evaṃ āvattayissan'ti yathā yathāvuttaṃ hatthiṃ hatth'ācariyo, evaṃ taṃ cittaṃ cittakaliṃ duccaritanisedhanato nivattayissāmi.

examples.text: yathā kuñjaraṃ adantaṃ, navaggaham'aṅkusaggaho, balavā āvatteti akāmaṃ, evaṃ āvattayissaṃ taṃ.

76432.meaning1: skilled in the taming of fine horses

examples.text: yathā varahayadamakusalo, sārathi pavaro dameti ājaññaṃ, evaṃ damayissaṃ taṃ, patiṭṭhito pañcasu balesu.

76433.meaning1: reined in by the yoke of effort; restrained by the yoke-pole of energy
76433.commentary: (THa) vīriyadhura-niggahito'ti yathāvutto chekena susārathinā yuge yojito yuganiggahito yug'antaragato taṃ n'ātikkamati, evaṃ tvam'pi citta, mama vīriyadhure niggahito sakkaccakāritāya sātaccakāritāya aññathā vattituṃ alabhanto ito gocar'ajjhattato dūraṃ bahi na gamissasi. bhāvan'ānuyuttassa hi kammaṭṭhānato aññaṃ āsannam'pi lakkhaṇato dūram'evā'ti evaṃ thero imāhi gāthāhi attano cittaṃ niggaṇhanto'va vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.

examples.text: satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payutto te damessāmi, vīriyadhura-niggahito, na y'ito dūraṃ gamissase cittā'ti.

76434.meaning1: yoke of effort; load of energy
76434.commentary: (THa) vīriyadhura-niggahito'ti yathāvutto chekena susārathinā yuge yojito yuganiggahito yug'antaragato taṃ n'ātikkamati, evaṃ tvam'pi citta, mama vīriyadhure niggahito sakkaccakāritāya sātaccakāritāya aññathā vattituṃ alabhanto ito gocar'ajjhattato dūraṃ bahi na gamissasi.

examples.text: satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payutto te damessāmi, vīriyadhuraniggahito, na y'ito dūraṃ gamissase cittā'ti.

76435.commentary: (THa) vihāre ca sah'āvasin'ti na kevalaṃ tassa bhagavato dassanam'eva mayā laddhaṃ, atha kho vihāre satthu gandhakuṭiyaṃ satthārā kāraṇaṃ sallakkhetvā vāsentena saha avasiṃ.

examples.text: upasampadā ca me laddhā, vimutto c'amhi anāsavo, so ca me bhagavā diṭṭho, vihāre ca sah'āvasiṃ.
bahu'd'eva rattiṃ bhagavā, abbhokāse-atināmayi, vihārakusalo satthā, vihāraṃ pāvisī tadā.
bahu'd'eva rattiṃ bhagavā, abbhokāse'tināmayi, vihārakusalo satthā, vihāraṃ pāvisī tadā.

76438.meaning1: having laid out; having spread out
76438.commentary: (THa) santharitvāna saṅghāṭiṃ, seyyaṃ kappesī'ti catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi. ten'āha gotamo sīho selaguhāyaṃ'va pahīnabhayabheravo'ti.

examples.text: santharitvāna saṅghāṭiṃ, seyyaṃ kappesi gotamo, sīho selaguhāyaṃ'va, pahīnabhayabheravo.
santharitvāna saṅghāṭiṃ, seyyaṃ kappesi gotamo, sīho selaguhāyaṃ'va, pahīnabhayabheravo.

76440.meaning1: understanding the words; comprehending the speech (of)
76440.commentary: (THa) vacanaññū'ti tesaṃ anusāsanīvacanaṃ jānanto, yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjamāno paṭipajjitvā ca tassa phalaṃ jānanto'ti attho.

examples.text: yo ve garūnaṃ vacanaññu dhīro, vase ca tamhi janayetha pemaṃ, so bhattimā nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.

76441.grammar: pr, caus of na chambhati, neg, trans (+acc)
76441.meaning1: does not cause one to be frozen stiff; does not cause one to be paralysed with fear

examples.text: yaṃ āpadā uppatitā uḷārā, nakkhambhayante paṭisaṅkhayantaṃ, so thāmavā nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.

76442.grammar: prp of caus of pati saṃ √khā, trans (+acc)
76442.meaning1: making reflect; causing to carefully consider

examples.text: yaṃ āpadā uppatitā uḷārā, nakkhambhayante paṭisaṅkhayantaṃ, so thāmavā nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.

76443.meaning1: fell forward in reverence; prostrated oneself; bowed at the feet
76443.commentary: (THa) na tāv'āhaṃ paṇipatin'ti yāva maṃ bhagavā n'eva kho tvaṃ, kassapa, arahā, n'āpi arahattamaggaṃ samāpanno, sā'pi te paṭipadā n'atthi, yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assa, arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpanno'ti na tajjesi, tāva ahaṃ na paṇipātanaṃ akāsiṃ.

examples.text: disvāna pāṭihīrāni, gotamassa yasassino, na tāv'āhaṃ paṇipatiṃ, issāmānena vañcito.

76444.meaning1: jealousy and pride; envy and conceit
76444.commentary: (THa) issāmānena vañcito, imassa mayi sāvakattaṃ upagate mama lābhasakkāro parihāyissati, imassa eva vaḍḍhissatī'ti evaṃ parasampattiasahanalakkhaṇāya issāya c'eva, ahaṃ gaṇapāmokkho bahujanasammato'ti evaṃ abbhunnatilakkhaṇena mānena ca vañcito, palambhito hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: disvāna pāṭihīrāni, gotamassa yasassino, na tāv'āhaṃ paṇipatiṃ, issāmānena vañcito.
pubbe jaṭilabhūtassa, yā me siddhi parittikā, t'āhaṃ tadā nirākatvā, pabbajiṃ jinasāsane.

76446.meaning1: giving importance to the world of sense pleasures; preferred material things
76446.commentary: (THa) kāmadhātupurakkhato'ti kāmasugatiṃ ārabbha uppannataṇho yaññayajanena kāmalokaṃ purakkhatvā ṭhito.

examples.text: pubbe yaññena santuṭṭho, kāmadhātupurakkhato, pacchā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, mohañ'cā'pi samūhaniṃ.

76447.meaning1: uprooted; eradicated; exterminated; utterly destroyed; got rid of; killed off
76447.commentary: (THa) samūhanin'ti vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca mohañca anavasesato samugghātesiṃ.

examples.text: pubbe yaññena santuṭṭho, kāmadhātupurakkhato, pacchā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, mohañ'cā'pi samūhaniṃ.

76448.meaning1: knowing the minds of others; understanding the heart of another
76448.commentary: (THa) sarāg'ādi-bhedassa paresaṃ cittassa jānanato paracittaññū, cetopariyañāṇalābhī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ, iddhimā paracittaññū, dibbasotañ'ca pāpuṇiṃ.

seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro, evam'evaṃ te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.

76451.meaning1: speaking confidently; making a bold assertion

examples.text: nadato parisāyaṃ te, vāditabbapahārino, ye te dakkhanti vadanaṃ, dhaññā te narapuṅgava.

76452.meaning1: noble one; best being; foremost person
76452.commentary: (APAa) sakyapuṅgavaṃ sakyakulajeṭṭhakaṃ bhagavantaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesasattesu koci'pi paññāya me mayā samo n'atthī'ti dīpeti. ten'āha, ahaṃ aggo'mhi paññāya, sadiso me na vijjatī'ti.

examples.text: nadato parisāyaṃ te, vāditabbapahārino, ye te dakkhanti vadanaṃ, dhaññā te narapuṅgava.
seyyathā'pi brāhmaṇa dakkho assadammako bhaddaṃ ass'ājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhamen'eva mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti atha uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti
tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.

76455.notes: Theragāthā verse 16 (TH1.16, TH16) is attributed to him.

examples.text: cūḷavaccho mahāvaccho, vanavaccho ca sīvako, kuṇḍadhāno ca belaṭṭhi, dāsako ca tat'opari, siṅgālapitiko thero, kulo ca ajito dasā'ti.

76456.notes: Theragāthā verse 18 (TH1.18, TH18) is attributed to him.

examples.text: cūḷavaccho mahāvaccho, vanavaccho ca sīvako, kuṇḍadhāno ca belaṭṭhi, dāsako ca tat'opari, siṅgālapitiko thero, kulo ca ajito dasā'ti.

76457.meaning1: taking pleasure in adornment; enjoying beautifying oneself
76457.commentary: (THa) bhūsanārato'ti attabhāvavibhūsanāya rato abhirato, yath'ekacce pabbajitvā'pi capalā kāyadaḷhibahulā cīvar'ādiparikkhārassa attano sarīrassa ca maṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānāya yuttā honti. kim'eva parikkhārapasuto bhūsanārato ca n'āhosī'ti ayam'ettha padadvayassā'pi attho.

examples.text: kacci no vatthapasuto, kacci no bhūsanārato, kacci sīlamayaṃ gandhaṃ, kiṃ tvaṃ vāyasi n'etarā pajā'ti.

76458.commentary: (THa) bhūsanārato'ti attabhāvavibhūsanāya rato abhirato, yath'ekacce pabbajitvā'pi capalā kāyadaḷhibahulā cīvar'ādiparikkhārassa attano sarīrassa ca maṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānāya yuttā honti. kim'eva parikkhārapasuto bhūsanārato ca n'āhosī'ti ayam'ettha padadvayassā'pi attho.

examples.text: kacci no vatthapasuto, kacci no bhūsanārato, kacci sīlamayaṃ gandhaṃ, kiṃ tvaṃ vāyasi n'etarā pajā'ti.

76459.commentary: (THa) atha vā n'etarā pajā'ti na itarā dussīlapajā, taṃ kacci na hoti, yato sīlamayaṃ gandhaṃ vāyasī'ti byatirekena sīlagandhavāyanam'eva vibhāveti.

examples.text: kacci no vatthapasuto, kacci no bhūsanārato, kacci sīlamayaṃ gandhaṃ, kiṃ tvaṃ vāyasi n'etarā pajā'ti.

76460.commentary: (THa) tato paṭṭhāya devamanussesu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe ibbhakule nibbatto gosālo nāma nāmena. soṇena pana koṭikaṇṇena kataparicayattā tassa pabbajitabhāvaṃ sutvā so'pi nāma mahāvibhavo pabbajissati, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti sañjātasaṃvego bhagavato santike pabbajitvā cariy'ānukūlaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā sappāyaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gavesanto attano jātagāmassa avidūre ekasmiṃ sānupabbate vihāsi. tassa mātā divase divase bhikkhaṃ deti. ath'ekadivasaṃ gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa mātā madhusakkhar'ābhisaṅkhataṃ pāyāsaṃ adāsi.
76460.notes: Theragāthā verse 23 (TH1.23, TH23) is attributed to him.

examples.text: nigrodho cittako thero, gosālathero sugandho, nandiyo abhayo thero, thero lomasak'aṅgiyo, jambugāmikaputto ca, hārito uttiyo isī'ti.

76461.notes: Theragāthā verse 36 (TH1.36, TH36) is attributed to him.

76462.notes: Theragāthā verse 67 (TH1.67, TH67) is attributed to him.

examples.text: vappo ca vajjiputto ca, pakkho vimalakoṇḍañño, ukkhepakatavaccho ca, meghiyo ekadhammiko, ek'udāniyachannā ca, puṇṇatthero mahabbalo'ti.

76463.notes: Theragāthā verse 77 (TH1.77, TH77) is attributed to him.

examples.text: vacchapālo ca yo thero, ātumo māṇavo isi, suyāmano susārado, thero yo ca piyañjaho, ārohaputto meṇḍasiro, rakkhito uggasavhayo'ti.

76464.commentary: (THa) na tāva supituṃ hoti, ratti nakkhattamālinī'ti aṭṭhahi akkhaṇehi vajjitaṃ navamaṃ khaṇaṃ labhitvā ṭhitassa viññujātikassa yāva na arahattaṃ hatthagataṃ hoti, tāva ayaṃ nakkhattamālinī ratti supituṃ niddāyituṃ na hoti, supanassa kālo na hoti.
